nuclear_capex.conversion_rule: source USD value multiplied by 2025 USD/CNY; do not apply China CPI to the historical CNY conversion

fuel_prices.conversion_rule: source USD values multiplied by 2025 USD/CNY and held constant in real terms through 2060
fuel_prices.temporal_interpretation: structural provincial fuel-cost assumptions, not a 2025 spot-price forecast

wave_energy.conversion_rule: source EUR values multiplied by 2025 EUR/CNY; do not apply China CPI

excluded_from_price_rebasing: fractions, efficiencies, heat rates, lifetimes and WACC
planning_year_rule: Apply one common source-to-target price-basis conversion to every planning-year value in a trajectory. Do not inflate 2030, 2040, 2050 or 2060 separately.
